static_traits.name: Ivy
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends who can provide support, but she often hesitates to share her feelings
static_traits.medical_history: 过去not yet出现类似心理问题;not yet接受过心理治疗;without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑尚可;语气偏消极,倾向自我比较与negate;在咨询中虽not乐观但愿意尝试;语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我常常negate积极反馈或成就,觉得相比他人它们毫Meaninglessness,这导致我感到not够好与自我价值低.
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到not断negate积极反馈正在影响我的自尊和整体幸福感,因此寻求咨询.
growth_experiences: 约一年前开始在工厂Work,频繁接受上司反馈,逐步形成与同事的比较习惯;随着时间推移,Self-denial与低自尊加重.在此之前not yet出现类似问题.

core_beliefs: 我的成就not重要/not值得被认可

special_situations.event: The boss praised me at the factory, but also praised two other people at the same time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果表扬not是仅属于我,我have not明显优于他人,就not算成就
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过与他人比较并negate正面信息来维持自我标准,避免因'not够好'而受挫

special_situations.event: Receiving positive comments at a work feedback meeting
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果赞美可能出于客套或管理策略,就not值得相信
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributing others' praise to 'just trying to motivate me', in order to protect oneself from expectation and disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are only trying to motivate me; they probably say that to everyone

special_situations.event: Seeing colleagues perform well or many being praised
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must be better than others to have value, otherwise I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断与同事比较以检验自我价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们;我的成就not重要

special_situations.event: Recalling the day's work performance after work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要有not足就说明我整体not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复Reflection与挑错,忽略当天的优点和成绩
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Performed very poorly today; I should have done better

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and have one's worth seen
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate,在比较中显得without能
defense_goal: 通过negate积极反馈和减少与同事的接触来降低被评价的风险
Maintains distance to preserve a sense of safety and avoid being hurt

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的,容易被比较而显得逊色的员工
object_relations.object_representation: 上司/同事是评判者,可能not真诚的认可者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes that 'positive feedback may be sincere' and invites reality testing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为对方忽视她的真实not足,只是试图让她改变想法(移情:将他人动机理解为管理策略)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explaining in a calm but skeptical tone that 'they just want to motivate me', weakening the positive side and avoiding directly acknowledging one's strengths.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share feelings with friends or colleagues and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认为表达会给他人带来负担,因此not应说出感受
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Answers briefly, avoids in-depth emotional description, tone restrained, turns instead to talking about objective facts.

manifestations: 把积极反馈视为'not意义''not真实',认为成就因他人也被表扬而not重要
Withdraws from colleague interactions, less communication
Hesitating to share feelings with friends

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Interprets the boss's praise as 'just politeness / a motivational strategy'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 用'I am not good enough'的标准苛责自己

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Reduced communication with colleagues at work
Turning the urge to communicate into nighttime self-rumination and self-criticism

positive_force: Willing to try challenging automatic thoughts (open to reality testing)
Has received positive feedback from a superior at work (objective positive evidence exists)
Has a few reliable friends as potential support
能觉察并命名自身的负性思维模式(如negate正面,心理过滤,个人化)
negative_force: Excessive comparison and dependence on external evaluation; tends to define self-worth by others' performance
negate正向反馈,以读心术方式Interpretation他人动机
Sleep impaired与精力低下,形成负性循环
Social withdrawal, less interaction and support

antecedent: When receiving work feedback or praise from the boss
Seeing colleagues also praised or performing well
target_behavior.core_reason: 进入工厂后处于高比较与频繁反馈的环境,Reinforcement了'I am not good enough'的认知,导致将赞美视为not真实或not重要
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的失望与被negate感,维持Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem,Work performance affected,难以巩固积极行为

target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被评价与显得without能,担心被negate
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships受损,Decreased support,Increased sense of isolation

antecedent: 下班后Reflection当天Work表现并聚焦not足
target_behavior.core_reason: Mental filtering and 'should'-style self-demands intensify self-criticism and worry
target_behavior.function: 试图通过过度Reflection获得控制与改进(但适得其反)
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality,精力低下,WorkReduced motivation
